name: HDMI CEC Control +
author: Nick Scilingo (FocusedOnSound)
description: HDMI CEC control for Falcon Player — power your TV or PC monitor on/off, switch inputs, and control volume directly from FPP playlists, schedules, and GPIO triggers. Supports CEC-capable TVs and PC monitors via DDC/CI (ddcutil). Free for personal use.

privacy.summary: Controls your TV/monitor over the local HDMI-CEC or DDC/CI bus. Makes no outbound network calls, collects no data about people, and has no sensors.

systemChanges.what: adds fpp to the i2c group and loads the i2c-dev kernel module, for DDC/CI monitor access
runs vcgencmd/tvservice/kmsblank/ddcutil via sudo, relying on FPP's existing sudo config (no sudoers file added)
